title: The 5 Lowest Places on Dry Land, Ranked (#1 Isn't Close)

scenes.text: The five lowest places on dry land. Number one is nearly three times deeper than number two.
Number five: the Karagiye depression in Kazakhstan. About one hundred thirty-two meters below sea level.
scenes.label: Karagiye · 132 m

scenes.text: Number four: Egypt's Qattara Depression. One hundred thirty-three meters below sea level, just one meter deeper than number five.
scenes.label: Qattara · 133 m

scenes.text: Number three: the Turpan Depression in China. About one hundred fifty-four meters below sea level.
scenes.label: Turpan · 154 m

scenes.text: Number two: Lake Assal in Djibouti. One hundred fifty-five meters down, beating Turpan by a single meter.
scenes.label: Lake Assal · 155 m

scenes.text: Number one: the Dead Sea. More than four hundred meters below sea level, the lowest dry land on Earth.
scenes.label: Dead Sea · 400+ m

description:
The five lowest places on dry land, ranked by depth below sea level.
The Dead Sea sits more than 400 meters below sea level, while number two, Lake Assal, is about 155 meters down.
Which one would you visit?
first_comment: Which would you put at number one? And what should we rank next?
